item.subject: science
item.stem: Meera reads in her school library book that astronomers have found a planet revolving around a star far outside our Solar System. Her friend Arjun asks what such a planet is called and where it belongs. Which statement is correct?

options.A: It is an exoplanet, and it lies in a galaxy beyond the Solar System.
options.B: It is a galaxy, because any planet revolving around another star is called a galaxy.
options.C: It is part of the Solar System, because every planet must revolve around our Sun.
options.D: It is proof that life exists there, because finding a planet means life has been found on it.
